title: Quaternary stratigraphy in the vicinity of Charleston, South Carolina, and its relationship to local seismicity and regional tectonism
citation: McCartan, Lucy, Weems, R.E., and Lemon, E.M., 1990, Quaternary stratigraphy in the vicinity of Charleston, South Carolina, and its relationship to local seismicity and regional tectonism: U.S. Geological Survey Professional Paper 1367-A, map scale 1:1,154,000.
notes:
Packet 1 of 2 (pp. 17-47). Page 18 (figure) had no text and was not OCRed. Heavy-mineral tables 3, 5-8 and clay table 4 not stored (no schema fields). Unit names are the report's informal units Q1-Q6 and lithofacies (OCR in the text writes 1 as l, e.g. Q21 = Q2l). Regional geology section continues into packet 2.
Packet 2 of 2 (pp. 48-59). Continues the regional geology section (Santee Limestone/Black Mingo) from packet 1. Table 9 heavy minerals not stored. Figure 16 column (Mount Pleasant) has no readable depths; layers listed top to bottom. Skipped references outside South Carolina (New Jersey, Delmarva, Australia, Gulf Coast, Florida, general clay and sea-level papers).
